data.name: Leopold
data.gender_notes: Leopold is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Leopold is a compound name derived from the Greek word leos, meaning 'lion', and the Latin word pallus, meaning 'wolf'. In early Germanic culture, both animals were revered for their strength and courage. The name Leopold was popular among early Christian monks and hermits, who adopted the name as a symbol of their inner strength and bravery. In the Bible, the Lion of Judah is a symbol of Jesus, the King of Kings. So, the name Leopold can be seen as a reminder of Jesus' strength and protection.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, bravery, and inner wisdom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leopold total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Leopold I, Holy Roman Emperor (1640-1705). He was born in Austria and ruled the Habsburg territories from 1657 to 1705. During his reign, Leopold expanded the Habsburg territories to their largest extent, and he played a key role in the War of the Spanish Succession.

historical_references.reference: Leopold II, King of Belgium (1831-1909). He succeeded his father, Louis-Philippe, in the Belgian throne in 1865. Leopold ruled Belgium until his death in 1909. He was known for his support of the arts and science, and for his colonial expansion in Africa.
